paragraphs.source_en: I am ashamed that I come from a land of ancient civilization. I am ashamed that the blood of ancient ancestors still runs in my veins. I am ashamed that the Yangtze’s flowing waves are now muddied. I am ashamed—facing the clear and lofty Fuji! In the age of early Tang, its vigor has always lingered in my dreams: the moonlit Luoyang of that time, the sunshine of Chang’an of that time; the crying apes of the Shu road then, the roaring waves of Wuxia then; and also that mournful pipa in the deep night at Xunyang. Yet these millennia of numbness, millennia of bewilderment: I can no longer even recognize— the former grace and composure of the Hua lineage! What violent whirlwind is this that tramples the art of life? —— Remembering the white bones strewn across the Central Plains, I cannot keep silent. I am a drifting yellow leaf, adrift within a whirlwind, looking back to the great trunk I came from, now bare and withered, I am an ill-fated drop of water, crawling in a mud pit— yet the parched ravine too once had lively streams of water. I long to become a spring breeze, a breath of spring that fans life itself, to stir that lonely great tree and break apart its long, deep dream. I want a stubborn iron hoe to cut through the silted blockages and the bloated masses, to open the great hidden current, and let it surge once more through the cosmos. For this reason I envy these islanders, who still retain the old customs, in their plain countryside seeing—through modest life—the refined restraint, purity, and vastness of an ancient society; I dare not fail to pray for the restored splendor of the old homeland, and yet I also wish— that the dawn in the East may forever preserve Fusang’s beauty, the beautiful Fusang.

units.source_zh:
我慚愧我來自古文明的鄉國，

我慚愧我脈管中有古先民的遺血，

我慚愧揚子江的流波如今溷濁，

我慚愧——我面對著富士山的清越！

那時洛邑的月色，那時長安的陽光；

那時蜀道的啼猿，那時巫峽的濤響；

我是一枚漂泊的黃葉，在旋風裡漂泊，

我是一顆不幸的水滴，在泥潭里匍匐——

我要一把倔強的鐵鋤，剷除淤塞與臃腫,

開放那偉大的潛流，又一度在宇宙間洶湧。

為此我羨慕這島民依舊保持著往古的風尚，

我不敢不祈禱古家邦的重光，但同時我願望——

願東方的朝霞永葆扶桑的優美，優美的扶桑！
